main_text.head: DE REPVBLICA CARTHAGINIENSIVM.
main_text.p: EVIR[?] eodem tempore, quo floruit Lacedæmon, & sæculis proximè secutis, illustris quoque & præpotens civitas Carthaginiensis,in Africâ sita ipso in litore, cujus rempublicam liberam cum Lacedæmoniâ comparat[illegible, ~6 letters] Aristoteles, politicorum lib. ii, cap. ix. Hæc à Didone Phœnicià tyrannidem fratris Pigmalionis cum Phœnicibus aliis fugiente condita, regio imperio aliquandiu gubernata fuit. Deinde eo repudiato libertatem arripuit, ac priusquàm[illegible, ~4 letters] bene compositas res, & stabilem[illegible, ~3 letters] rectéque formatum statum obtinerent, varios casus est perpessa, quorum plerosque compendio recitat ex Trogo Iustinus[illegible, ~3 letters] historicus libro xix, & proximis sequentibus. In formandâ verò republicâ suâ fine dubio multa mutuata fuit à conditoribus suis Tyriis, quorum

page.notes: The large decorative initial is read as E; the first word printed in small capitals appears to be VIR, so the joined form EVIR is doubtful and marked [?]. Right-margin notes are faint and only partly legible; their placement and length are approximate. Left-margin marks and the ornament above the heading are not text and were left out.
